note: The entry is the stay case's [[representation.delivery_metadata]] for 1.5.ku, authored from _sources/scb-delivery-names-ku-agi (that case's delivery, unchanged) and built from the changed delivery below. The stale row's subject is the entry's `variable` and its locator the entry's file, table and index, both read from the curation fixture. A stale entry withholds its decision (the replaced tests assert `decision is None`); without the checked names KU's two delivery names conflict, so KU forms no state. Allowed twin of steps 2 and 3. Values from the replaced tests: register '  TESTREG  ' vs 'TESTREG' and population '  Hela befolkningen  ' vs 'Hela befolkningen' (whitespace test), Registersyfte 'Testning ' vs 'Testning' (parent-guard test, whitespace leg), a new artifact and new physical row positions (LISA test: changed revision, row and raw cell); each asserts the case stays applicable. Applicable means no stale_curation_entry and the checked names kept: one KU state per delivery, named by its own row (CVID 31, 2020, 'Income'; CVID 33, 2021, 'Taxable income' in the fixture). The LISA test's 'unprojected description change' leg is not here: TOML records are complete projections, so a description change stales every TOML-pinned entry.
fails_if: the SCB parent-fact cleaner `_parent_facts` (reg_meta_build/src/reg_meta_build/sources/scb_records.py) keeps the raw Registersyfte cell instead of `normalize_text` of it, so the purpose's trailing space differs from the authored parent facts and the entry goes stale. (Keeping the padded register or population name raw instead fails this step earlier: the resolved catalog refuses an untrimmed name.)

sources.description: The stay delivery with only raw and layout changes: rows in reverse order, the register and population names padded with spaces and the register purpose (Registersyfte) with a trailing space.
